in_sanskrit.name: शत्रुधनुष
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who gives or bears an enemy. The name of a popular actor in Indian cinema, Shatrughan Sinha.

in_hindi.name: शत्रुग्हन
in_hindi.long_meaning: The one who bears an enemy. (In Hindi, शत्रु means enemy, and धनुष means a bow. So, Shatrughan can be interpreted as one who wields a bow against an enemy.)

in_tamil.name: சத்துரோஜன
in_tamil.long_meaning: One who is the enemy of himself or one's own self. (In Tamil, சத்துர் means enemy, and ஜனம் means self or being. So, Shatrughan can be interpreted as one who is an enemy to oneself or one's own being.)

in_telugu.name: శత్రుఘన
in_telugu.long_meaning: One who has a large number of enemies. (In Telugu, శత్రు means enemy, and ఘన means a large number. So, Shatrughan can be interpreted as one who has a large number of enemies.)

in_marathi.name: Shatrughan
in_marathi.long_meaning: Shatrughan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who has many enemies or has the strength to protect from enemies

in_bengali.name: Shatrughan
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Having Enemies
in_bengali.long_meaning: Shatrughan একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। One who has many enemies or has the strength to protect from enemies
